notes.en: Aimed for a faithful Vitruvian Man with clear dual-pose overlay and correct Leonardo geometry — circle on the navel, square on the groin, eight-head proportions. Three detail tiers let the bold gold silhouette carry navbar sizes while aged-ink etching and cross-hatching add anatomical depth at larger renders. Weaknesses: the hands are simplified and converge to narrow tips rather than showing full palms, the raised-arm hands are very small at this angle, and the groin area where the two leg poses cross reads as busy at medium sizes.
